Arrays and data science

NumPy and pandas make Python the default for numeric and data work. Guion now has native arrays and a first-party data-frame library, frames, but both are young. In the project's reports on one Apple M1 Pro, frames finishes five tested CSV workloads before pandas does from start to finish, mostly because pandas takes about 0.26 s to load. On compute alone, reading a large CSV is still about 3 times pandas, and array maths is about 1.4 to 2.3 times NumPy's.

Earlier tests that reached NumPy through Python are retired and no longer cited. The speed report is in the repository's evaluation results.
